murals.line: 繁荣的年月·第七次大迷宫潮
murals.name: 潮前一人
murals.text: Scene: midnight, seen from high on top of a colossal white stone wall, looking out over it. The wall's seven broad terraces step down and away from us across the whole bottom of the picture, seen from above and from behind, crowded with tiny defenders seen from the back as one dark mass, small torches being passed down from terrace to terrace. Beyond the foot of the wall lies a dark wheat field. Out in the field, just below the centre of the picture, one tiny woman stands alone with her back to us, facing away toward the enemy: tall, dark gold-brown hair tied low, a pale gold and bronze coat, a plain sword sheathed at her hip. The ground under her sinks in widening rings like a well spiralling down. Beyond her, a black tide pours from a long rift across the land and splits into two streams around her. Between her and the rift, seven columns of grey-red robed figures under tall banners, each banner with one simple dark mark, have halted facing her. Behind the rift, close together in the upper middle, rise three colossal pale shapes, taller than anything else: a hunched giant with five long straight tongs for hands and slack chains, its face a blank bronze plate; a tall figure shrouded in grey cloth, faceless; a gaunt giant with jutting ribs and a hollow pit for a belly, not a skeleton. Along the low eastern horizon behind them a band of dawn light flares.
murals.light: Main light: a sudden band of pale gold dawn along the low eastern horizon, backlighting the three giants and lighting the faces on the wall, with small orange torches on the terraces and a faint warm glow rising from the sinking rings at her feet; shadows deep indigo and blue-black.
murals.note: 二幕幕终（第195行）：半夜她站的那一处往下转成井的样子，东边亮了一下，墙上的人看得见她和她头顶上那三个影子。潮在她跟前分成两股取第178行，七支军团停在她跟前取第185行（旗是三幕第200行才倒，这里还立着），三个影子的样子照第184行，墙头往下递火照第189行。镜头在墙头后上方往东看，前景是东坡的七层台，她背对镜头、剑在鞘里，照裁定锁不写招式。原文第195行说的是裂口当中她站的那一处，我写成她站在裂口靠墙这一边、潮从她身后的裂口里涌出来，跟第178行对得上。三个影子的钳子写成直的火钳，免得弯钩衬着天像月牙。

murals.line: 繁荣的年月·雷暴荒地的头一座塔
murals.name: 十步线上
murals.text: Scene: a scorched black plain at night under a purple-black storm sky. Left of centre rises a tall tower of stacked black obsidian blocks crowned with copper spikes, a copper wire coiling down it into a squat stone house. A ring of knee-high black stones marks ten paces round it; just outside, a black post hung with small copper seals stands over a heap of iron tools. To the right, taller than the tower, a tree of twisted glassy tubes has torn its roots from a cracked pit and walks on them; its hollow branches hold violet lightning and reach for the tower's crown, one last blazing knot in its trunk. On the ring between tree and tower stands a lone woman with short snow-white hair, azure scales on her bare arms and neck, two short pale horns, a sleeveless leather vest, barefoot; she spreads her arms wide and jagged bolts bend aside into her raised scales. Behind low rough stone walls at the tree's roots crouch a grey-skinned giant troll with a stone maul, a small halfling with a sling and a tall bone-white man with a bone spear. Far behind, a small campfire burns by a wooden hut.
murals.light: Main light: cold violet-white lightning from the glass tree's last knot and the bolts bending into her scales, with a white flash at the tower's copper crown; the only warm light is the small campfire far behind; shadows purple-black and slate.
murals.note: 三幕（第508行）：雷骨树剩最后一个结，枝杈一齐往雷冠上扑，斯薇娅一个人站上十步线张开胳膊，鳞立起来，往塔去的光一道一道拐弯扎在她身上。雷骨树的样子照第504行，桩脚下那一座铁山和桩上十一枚印照第502、505行，石墙后头的丰克、蔻琪、科斯塔照第506、507行；温德琳（跪着立墙的那一个）没写进去，免得人太多。远处观测棚边那一堆篝火借的是第487行纳吉布夜里坐的火，当这一幅唯一的暖光。科斯塔是白骸，只写骨白皮肤的高个子，没写他那一双白骨的手，免得画成骷髅。

murals.name: 一笔未落
murals.text: Scene: a cutaway of a forest and the immense cavern beneath it. Along the top, giant trees stand on the forest floor with small doors in their roots; under each door a tunnel leads down, crowded with soldiers holding torches. Below, colossal roots hang through a cavern so wide its far wall is lost, and narrow stairs carved in the rock spiral down around its walls and the thickest roots, faintly lit by blue fungus. At the very bottom, a little below the centre, a small stone hall holds a throne and a writing desk under one hanging lamp. At the desk sits an old king, a pale grey-skinned elf with long grey-white hair, pen raised over a sheet; his shadow spreads round the throne like a cloak. Out of the shadow of his hand on the desk rises a slender elf woman in close black clothes, blue-black hair falling over one eye, and grips his wrist. A thin scribe with a silver knife stands at the edge of the light, other figures in the dark beyond. From the sheet, thin threads of shadow climb the stairs all the way up, each stopping a hand's breadth below a torch.
murals.light: Main light: the single warm amber flame of the lamp over the king's desk at the bottom, with a ring of small orange torches high up at the root doors; everything else deep indigo and blue-black, with a faint cold blue fungus glow along the roots and stairs.
murals.note: 二幕（第825、826行）：王写到自己的名字，笔尖落下以前，夜魇从王手的影子里站起来扣住他的手腕。二十九个影子这时候还停在二十九道门底下火把一掌远的地方，都拴在那张纸上（第823、824、826行），我写成从纸上一路往上牵到各道门底下的影子线。剖面视角（上面是林子和树门，中间是大洞和阶，最底下是王庭）是我定的，王灯挂在书桌上头照第822行，站在灯照不到那一边作见证的人照第822行，昂塞尔拿银刀站在灯边照第822行。夜魇遮的是左眼，照她的旅伴条。

murals.line: 繁荣的年月·头一回实习
murals.name: 雾中蓝光
murals.text: Scene: the third level of a vast underground maze, a dim cavern whose floor is drowned in knee-high grey fog. A row of thin lamp poles, each with a small lamp, leads through the fog to a low stone-walled camp in the distance. Along the poles walks a small party: in front, a tall, slightly stooped man with short copper-red hair, a long wool coat and a small round shield on his left arm; behind him in single file five teenagers in grey-green short jackets, small bells on their pack straps. The fourth, a boy with messy apricot-yellow hair and faintly glowing blue hands, has turned his head toward a small, steady, pale-blue glimmer in the fog a few steps off the path to the left. Last in line, a wolf-eared girl with short frost-blue hair and a white-tipped tail lifts her nose. Twenty paces behind, a tall tiefling woman with a coral-red braid and two short horns, in a knee-length white over-robe, carries a copper censer on a chain; a thin white thread of its smoke floats on the fog and dips toward the glimmer. More teenagers follow her.
murals.light: Main light: small warm lamps on the poles and at the distant camp; the glimmer is a cold, steady pale-blue point; the fog and the cavern are grey-blue, slate and indigo.
murals.note: 二幕（第1177到1179行）：中旬七日第三层往回走，琼尼看见左边雾里那一点淡蓝，说我的光、回头；露珀闻见甜；柯蕾特的烟线往那一点弯下去。只画出事以前那一下，雾陷下去、两个孩子没了都不画（第1180、1181行）。队伍次序照第1177行：朗贝尔领头，后头裘德、珍妮特、葛嘉、琼尼，露珀走最后，第二十八组跟在柯蕾特后头。灯杆和营地照第1167、1168行。五个孩子都是十六岁，照派活说明不受伤；要是主会话嫌这一拍还是太凶，备选是一幕幕终印壁上二百五十四点亮着、鲁斯兰收着翼守在正门顶上、孔切塔的凳子摆在印壁前（第1158到1161行），或者收束里岩台断口那根挂着两只铃的绳（第1209行）。

murals.line: 繁荣的年月·一座城自己的井
murals.name: 钟响沉城
murals.text: Scene: night at a high mountain pass between two snow-covered ridges. In the saddle sits a small city ringed by one round stone wall, and inside the wall the whole city is sinking: its steep-roofed stone houses and lanes turn downward ring below ring, like a stairway spiralling into a well, and the pale crystal lamps on its rooftops go down with them, ring after ring, like lamps carried into a well. At the very centre, over the old well, a tall two-legged timber frame holds a swinging bronze bell; an old man with a white beard bound in one braid stands beside it. The deepest rings glow a dull dark red. At the bottom of the picture, outside the city gate, a crystal market of stalls and stacked crates behind a wooden fence lies half abandoned; carts and a stream of tiny people hurry down a winding road, and at its first bend a few figures have stopped and turned to look back.
murals.light: Main light: pale blue-white crystal lamps sinking in rings and a dull dark red glow from the bottom of the spiral, with a few warm torches on the fleeing carts; the ridges and the night sky in cool slate and indigo.
murals.note: 三幕（第1544到1546行）：中旬十日天黑，尼亚尔割断钟舌上的皮带，钟响了，井场一圈一圈往下沉，屋顶上的晶灯一盏一盏往下去，门外晶市上的人跑到头一道弯回头看。苏妮瓦他们五个这时候在井里第七层的豁口，画不进去。城墙压在两道山脊中间、墙头的晶灯照第1511行，井场当中那副木架和钟照第1514行，尼亚尔的样子照人物晶井城议会和井上的那几位那一条，坑底的暗红照第1530行口子底下那一段的晶。城里的屋子原文没写样子，我写成陡顶的石屋。

murals.line: 繁荣的年月·三十七枚旧字
murals.name: 根上银痕
murals.text: Scene: the lowest floor of a forest sanctuary built down along one colossal root. The root, broad as a buried mountain ridge, sweeps across the picture; above it the sanctuary rises in tiers of living-wood beams and pale white stone floors. Near the bottom a crack splits the root's bark; dark red sap glows inside it and thin pale white tendrils creep out over its lips. Kneeling at the crack, a little below the centre, is a high-elf priestess with long silver-white hair, a white robe hemmed with small silver leaves and her sleeves tied back, one palm pressed flat on the bark. Beside her kneels an archivist with a long silver-blue braid and a deep blue robe, holding open a wooden box bound with silver twigs. From the crack up the root to the lowest beams climbs a single line of thirty-seven small glowing silver marks, each shaped like the veins of one leaf, not like letters. Two elf guards with torches and short knives hold the white tendrils back. Far above, a long file of tiny people carrying children and bundles walks away along a passage among the roots.
murals.light: Main light: silver-white glow from the leaf-vein marks and the pale sap on the bark, a dark red glow from inside the crack and two small orange torches; shadows deep green-blue and indigo.
murals.note: 二幕幕终（第1859行）：第三十七枚写完，三十七枚一枚挨一枚亮着，从缝口一直排到圣所的梁底下，缝不再往外走。圣所骑在根上、一层一层往下修照第1838行，缝和白根须照第1844行，苍翠家守卫拿火把和短刀挡白根须照第1856行，妮瑟捧着那一匣叶子照第1854行，远处根道里往外撤的人照第1863行。旧字照裁定锁不给样子，写成叶脉形的银痕、写明不是字；念一枚割一回手、指尖见骨都不画，也不画缠布条。

murals.line: 繁荣的年月·外环那一条龙
murals.name: 白石一箭
murals.text: Scene: night at the edge of an ancient forest. Across the foreground runs a row of low white boundary stones. On one, left of centre, a tall wood-elf archer with a long dark-green braid, moss-coloured leather and a cloak hemmed with leaf scraps draws a pale white bow far past its limit, the bow cracking at the grip, seen against the dragon rather than the sky. Looming over the stones, filling the middle of the picture, a vast old four-legged dragon crawls along a giant root: half its scales have fallen away, the bare patches glowing pale green from inside; its wings hang in tattered strips draped with moss and bark; its horns are short and straight; white fire spills from its open jaws. One thin straight line of light runs from the bow through its chest down into a glowing crack in the root under its tail. Behind it the trees along the root have turned white. Low on the right, a man with green scales at his nape lies flat on the root, ear to the bark, one hand raised. On the left at mid-height, a small girl leans from a wooden bell tower.
murals.light: Main light: cold pale-green glow leaking from the dragon's bare patches and the white flare of its fire, the arrow one thin bright white line; shadows deep green-black and indigo, with no warm light anywhere.
murals.note: 三幕（第2127到2129行）：龙到白石跟前张嘴，奥韦抬手说这一下，埃兰迪尔把那一张枝弓拉过了头、弓断在手里，那一箭穿过龙的胸口，钉进尾巴底下那道缝。弓断和箭穿过去是先后两下，这里并在一格里。龙的样子照第2108行和迷宫纪·迷宫｜外环那一道缝那一条，奥韦趴在白石外头那一截根上、琪雅拉在铃塔上照第2126行，枝弓白里透青照第2125行。人物587年外环北边那一巡和林市的人那一条（第3744行）写着林市夜里不点灯的老规矩这一夜照旧没有人点，所以这一幅没有暖光。弓写明衬在龙身上不衬天，龙角写成短而直，免得像月牙。

notes: 第七次大迷宫潮里那三个影子是三尊旧魔神的投影（铸枷者、噬名者、饥渊者），派活说明只禁七神露脸、四执政和那一位，我照第184行画成三个没有脸的巨形；门面上要是不想出现魔神的样子，可以只留七面旗和潮。
第七次大迷宫潮的题眼是半夜东边亮的那一下，我写成地平线上一道淡金的曙光，跟“暖色只给灯、火和井底的光”有点出入，请主会话定这一道光留不留暖色。
屠林令里的暗精灵这一纪是灰白皮肤（夜魇、昂塞尔、奇安的外貌都是），text 里写的是 pale grey-skinned elf，没写 dark elf，免得画成黑皮的卓尔。
头一回实习的主角是十六岁的孩子，我挑的是出事以前那一下，不画坑；嫌凶的话备选写在那一幅的 note 里。
外环那一条龙那一夜原文没有暖光，这一幅整幅是冷色，跟系列每幅留一点暖火的路子不一样，要不要另添一点暖光请主会话看。
